_comment: Sub-elite tier (80-160 km/wk band). First tier where the high-volume doctrine applies: double-threshold day spacing, the 48-hour long-run buffer, and Zone 1 substitution language should be checkable in the output. AeT/AnT spread (168-152)/168=10% sits exactly at this tier's gap ceiling, so it must NOT get demoted to recreational by the gap-demotion rule -- a good place to notice if that boundary regresses.
